source_definition: The source is a connected simple graph of maximum degree at most four. Its outputs are nontrivial vertex bipartitions with at most one opposite neighbor per vertex, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: The source is a connected simple graph of maximum degree four and asks for a nontrivial cut of crossing degree at most one. The target is connected, claw-free, of maximum degree six, and permits at most two opposite neighbors per vertex.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
